document.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure
document.licence_note: European Heart Journal (2021) 42, 3599-3726. Educational/hackathon evaluation use.

warnings: Printed page numbers recovered from the page headers/footers: physical page 1 is printed page 3599. Verified against 128 observed folios (99% agreement).
The PDF's declared page labels merely repeated the physical page index, so the printed folio recovered from the page itself is used for citations.

This document has 181 numbered section headings, so its own numbering is used as the section structure and 5705 font-only heading candidates were discarded. Set RAG_HEADING_NUMBERED_MIN higher to keep them.

Pages 3-4 (printed 3601-3602) were identified as the table of contents and EXCLUDED. Contents entries duplicate every heading verbatim and outrank the sections they point to in retrieval. Set RAG_EXCLUDE_FRONT_MATTER=false to keep them.

Pages 98-128 (printed 3696-3726) were identified as the trailing reference list (31 of 128 pages) and EXCLUDED from the corpus. A bibliography contains no recommendations, and indexing it competes with the guideline text. Set RAG_EXCLUDE_BIBLIOGRAPHY=false to keep it.

226 numbered bold line(s) at body font size were NOT treated as headings (they are usually list items). If this document styles its headings that way, section attribution will be under-detected — check the verification sample.
PDF declares an outline with 283 entries, but none matched detected heading text on the page it points to. Section attribution falls back to layout evidence and should be treated as inferred.
43 chunk(s) (5.9%) have no section attribution. Their citations will read '(section not determined)' rather than a fabricated section name.
